title: Hero image replaced by third-party contribution — 41h ago
narrative: Re-pushes go first: getting our own content back does not wait on a dispute. Then the pipeline fixes, so the repairs are not undone by the next cycle.
status_note: Execute · 0 of 4 stages · re-pushes go before disputes

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

plan.name: Canonical re-pushes
plan.meta: 8 fields across 3 channels · every push carries a diff and a version snapshot

items.name: Hero image · ASIN B0Y
items.detail: Canonical asset restored first, before any dispute is filed. The $310/day stops on this push, not on the case decision.

items.name: Price · Filtration Pitcher
items.detail: Cache purged and canonical price re-pushed, with price excluded from the theme cache so a rebuild cannot serve a stale value again.

items.name: Bullets, A+ modules and image sets
items.detail: Brand copy, both missing A+ modules and the full seven-image set restored from canonical, with the scale reference back in position three.

plan.name: Pipeline fixes and replay
plan.meta: template patch, partial-file guard, 412 rejected rows replayed

items.name: Feed template character limit
items.detail: Template v10 corrects the Walmart title limit, then replays across all four listings. Re-pushing values without this would have been undone on the next cycle.

items.name: Partial-file guard armed
items.detail: An inventory or content file that arrives incomplete is now rejected rather than applied to the rows it reached. This is what zeroed a live SKU for nine hours.

items.name: 412 rejected rows queued for replay
items.detail: Country-of-origin mapped, CDN URL expiry extended past the retry window, GTIN corrected against the repack. A regression check runs on the next cycle and reports row-level results.

plan.name: Stranded resolutions
plan.meta: 5 blocks relisted · 1 routed to the markdown ladder

items.name: Variation family rebuilt · 210 units freed
items.detail: Rebuilding the Enamel family restores the parent and unstrands the largest block at the same time. The pooled reviews return with the structure.

items.name: Four blocks relisted
items.detail: Title patch lifts the suppression on the Sauté Pan, the Pitcher offer is recreated, the dimension attribute is added to the Knife Block, and the Skillet units are relabelled to the new GTIN.

items.name: Enamel Casserole · to the 9.9 ladder
items.detail: Already in the markdown cohort for the surcharge date. Relisting at list price would strand it again in six weeks, so it joins the ladder instead.

plan.name: Disputes and monitoring

items.name: Three registry disputes filed
items.detail: Image contribution, variation parent rights and the restricted-claim bullet, each filed with PIM version history and the registry entitlement attached.

items.name: Field locks and monitor upgrade
items.detail: Image lock armed on 38 entitled ASINs, price excluded from the theme cache, and 24 standard-lane listings moved to 30-minute critical checks.

items.name: Recurrence and stranded balance watches
items.detail: Per-listing drift recurrence, the time-to-detect KPI against its 4-hour target, and the stranded balance tracked to zero rather than to a lower number.
